name: Paneer Pepper Fry
steps: Pat paneer cubes dry and season with 3 g salt and half the crushed pepper. Sear in 15 ml hot coconut oil for 2 minutes per side; remove.
Heat remaining oil in the same pan. Sizzle mustard seeds and curry leaves, then add garlic and slit green chilies for 30 seconds.
Add onion petals and stir-fry over medium-high heat for 4 minutes, leaving them slightly crisp. Sprinkle turmeric and remaining salt.
Return paneer to the pan. Add remaining freshly crushed pepper and toss 2 minutes until the paneer is coated with the dark peppery spices.
Turn off heat, squeeze lime juice over the dry fry, and serve immediately with paratha or as a side.
tips: Crush pepper just before cooking; pre-ground pepper loses the sharp aroma that defines this dish.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
